analyst.text: These teams have discussed a Jalen Green for Dejounte Murray swap that reportedly has zero traction, which adds an awkward edge to the night. Phoenix have won three straight and seven of nine; New Orleans have lost three straight, Zion Williamson was a late scratch on Saturday with a thigh contusion and Murray (trade request) is out. The angle leans towards Phoenix.
